    Open-source index

    Every public repo behind these docs, one line each, with the article that explains it.

    Updated 2026-10-05·4 min read

    Every public repo that relates to these docs, one line each, with the article that explains it. All of them live under github.com/jddavenportOpen, and each one was checked with a logged-out request on October 5, 2026. My private system stays private because it runs my actual life and work. These are the parts that generalize.

    Most are MIT licensed; check each repo's license file before you reuse code. Where a repo's own README quotes an agent count, it was true when that README was written; the durable phrasing is 30+ agents in daily production, 100+ built over time.

    #Production core

    The safety, governance and orchestration pieces, extracted from the system that runs every day.

    RepoWhat it isRead
    wardenA governor for autonomous agents: autonomy admitted by reversibility, not confidence. Zero dependencies, offline testsAuto bug-squash and the Warden
    claude-bug-squashPoint Claude Code at a repo and a bug: it fixes in an isolated worktree, proves red to green, gates the fix, and never merges out of the boxAuto bug-squash and the Warden
    ethos-gatePreToolUse and Stop hooks that block irreversible or outward-facing actions unless a human approved themHooks
    claude-deploy-kitEnterprise controls for Claude agents: a policy chokepoint, a destructive-command deny hook, an eval gate, a redacting audit log, pluggable secretsOne door out: the send gate
    orchestra-agentsA small Python library for driving many Claude agents in parallel with guardrails and evals: fan-out, a durable bus, circuit breakersOrchestration: delegate down, verify up
    clawd-agent-osTiered agent hierarchies with worktree-isolated fleets, a durable agent bus and one model registry as the source of truthFleets: parallel build agents
    hub-watchdogA two-strike uptime watchdog that runs on GitHub Actions, so it keeps working when the machine it watches is downWatchdogs
    agent-safety-case-studyA capability-versus-risk case study of running an AI organization in production: each capability, its risk, the control, an incidentThe architecture in one page
    claude-code-behavior-specsTarget-behavior specs for the Claude Code CLI written from production incidents, each with a reproduction and the workaround that shippedLessons from running agents every day
    nerve-center-showcaseThe capabilities page my system regenerates from live state every day (live page)The system documents itself
